question: How many orders are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;

question: How many orders were canceled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled';

question: How many distinct product categories are there in the products table?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) FROM products;

question: What is the average review score?
sql: SELECT AVG(review_score) FROM order_reviews;

question: What is the total freight value across all order items?
sql: SELECT SUM(freight_value) FROM order_items;

question: How many customers are from the state of SP?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'SP';

question: What is the highest price of any item sold?
sql: SELECT MAX(price) FROM order_items;

question: List the distinct order statuses.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT order_status FROM orders;

question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017';

question: How many reviews gave a score of 5?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 5;

question: How many orders are there for each order status, from most to least?
sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY n DESC;

question: How many orders were placed by customers living in the city of sao paulo?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_city = 'sao paulo';

question: What are the top 5 product categories by total sales revenue? Use the English category names.
sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC, category LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average review score for each order status?
sql: SELECT o.order_status, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY avg_score DESC, o.order_status;

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2017?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: Which sellers have sold more than 1000 items?
sql: SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS items FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY items DESC, seller_id;

question: What is the total revenue from delivered orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';

question: What is the average delivery time in days for delivered orders?
sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

question: List the 5 products with the highest average selling price.
sql: SELECT product_id, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY avg_price DESC, product_id LIMIT 5;

question: How many payments were made with each payment type?
sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY n DESC, payment_type;

question: Which 10 orders have a total item value higher than the average order total?
sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(price) > (SELECT AVG(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(price) AS t FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)) ORDER BY total DESC, order_id LIMIT 10;

question: For each customer state, which product category (English name) has the highest revenue?
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT c.customer_state AS state, t.product_category_name_english AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY state, category), ranked AS (SELECT state, category, revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY revenue DESC, category) AS rn FROM x) SELECT state, category, revenue FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY state;

question: What is the month-over-month change in the number of orders during 2017?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, n, n - LAG(n) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change FROM m ORDER BY month;

question: How many delivered orders have no review?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND r.order_id IS NULL;

question: How many unique customers placed more than one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1);

question: Which 5 customer states have the highest percentage of delivered orders that arrived late?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_pct FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY late_pct DESC, c.customer_state LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average review score for orders delivered late versus on time?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY delivery ORDER BY delivery;

question: Show the total revenue per year for the health_beauty category.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: Which seller has the highest average review score among sellers with at least 50 reviewed orders?
sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders FROM order_items oi JOIN order_reviews r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY oi.seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) >= 50 ORDER BY avg_score DESC, orders DESC, oi.seller_id LIMIT 1;

question: Show the cumulative number of orders by month over the whole dataset.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY month) SELECT month, n, SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative FROM m ORDER BY month;
